# attested in language

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestedInLanguage`](gmeow-attestedInLanguage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedInLanguage>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The language, variety, or state in which the attested form was observed. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a multilingual source may attest the same form in multiple language contexts, or different standpoints may assign different language classifications to the same attestation.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) -> [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attestedInLanguage`](gmeow-attestedInLanguage.md) from [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md), [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to record the language, variety, or state in which the form was observed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single language (it is non-functional; a multilingual source may attest several) and avoid confusing the attestation's observed language with the item's fixed [`gmeow:lexicalItemLanguage`](gmeow-lexicalItemLanguage.md).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:attestedInLanguage`](gmeow-attestedInLanguage.md) at one or more [`gmeow:Language`](../classes/gmeow-Language.md) individuals; competing standpoint-specific language classifications of the same attestation coexist.

### Examples

- ex:att1 [`gmeow:attestedInLanguage`](gmeow-attestedInLanguage.md) ex:middleEnglish.
